root: ^Master Kokorin: You… you’ve freed me from this endless slumber.
^ The temple was under the Gorgorian’s sway while I slept.
^ Strange… the Stone Curse has twisted our world: statues now walk, and the living… have turned to stone.
^Cacildes: Stone Curse? What do you mean?
^Master Kokorin: Maerimond, the stone mage, has returned to haunt Uta Pendur.
^ Once, he was a mighty mage, betrayed by King Madhiva’s ancestors,
^ bound in shackles far across the sea in a kingdom called Slepbone…
^ there he remained, cursed in a stone sleep.
^Master Kokorin: But his slumber was broken… and now his curse spreads across the land once more.
^Cacildes: I… could this have something to do with me?
^Master Kokorin: Indeed. The trees themselves summoned you. Even now, you feel… unusual.
^ Fate has a strange way of guiding us, and it has brought you here. By your presence, the temple begins to heal.
^Master Kokorin: Tell me, will you attempt to save the kingdom of Uta Pendur?
^ The stone curse has surely spread far beyond this temple.
^As you said, it must be fate that brought me here.
^I could return to my kingdom any time and leave this be.

fate_choice: ^Master Kokorin: You have my gratitude—for saving the temple, and for freeing me from the stone curse.
^ Now I must protect our sacred trees, and guard against any more statues that may awaken to haunt us.
^Master Kokorin: I am certain our paths will cross again, hero. Until that day… may your courage never waver.
leave_choice: ^Master Kokorin: And yet, curiosity and destiny have led you here. A strange, yet fitting twist of fate.
^Master Kokorin: Even so, know that the curse will not wait. I will continue to protect the temple, but the world outside grows ever darker.
